fit: date and mango industry waste used as a cultivation substrate
assessment: The original abstract compares oyster mushroom yield and composition. Its best reported date and mango mixtures yielded 11.96% and 10.18%, respectively. No consumption or pain outcome.

fit: untreated or yeast-fermented date-waste fibre fed to rats
assessment: The original abstract verifies an eight-week comparison of nutrition and tissue measures. It supplies no pain, stool frequency, or Parkinson endpoint and the diets use processed fibre.

fit: review identifies mushroom polysaccharides after growth on date waste
assessment: The original review cites fungal extracts and an ascites tumor assay. A university bibliography gives the cited 2002 page range, with the body and its controls still open. Date processing waste is a growth medium.

fit: regional ethnopharmacological survey of gastrointestinal plant use
assessment: The El-Bayadh plant table and interview scope were verified. Its 62 species include no date palm. The separate 2000 Béchar report remains necessary to verify the date-fruit attribution.
